cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Consolidated cash is not split by parent/subsidiary; operations and principal subsidiaries are in Mainland China, so no quick offshore dividend path is proven.
cash_breakdown.reason: Unrestricted operating group cash, but only partially detachable under a controlling-owner cash extraction view.

cash_breakdown.item: Cash at other financial institutions - related party
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Related-party financial institution deposits are inside the CEC group treasury relationship and are not treated like plain listed-parent cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Interest-bearing related-party cash/deposits disclosed in notes 20 and 30.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Original maturity is three months or less, but location/entity split is not disclosed and group operations are mainly PRC subsidiaries.
cash_breakdown.reason: Short-term deposits with banks are cash-like but still need cross-entity extraction discount.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Original maturity is over three months and exact maturity/entity split is not disclosed; use conservative PRC subsidiary deposit haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Bank time deposits are funds assets but not all immediately detachable.

cash_breakdown.item: Time deposits at other financial institutions - related party
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Related-party treasury deposits with original maturity over three months; no evidence of immediate offshore availability.
cash_breakdown.reason: Funds asset with related-party and extraction-risk haircut.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Held mainly as security for bank acceptance bills.
RMB borrowings due within one year; shareholder loan and entrusted related-party loans are deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Financing debt must be repaid or netted against funds assets.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: The company has annual revenue of HK$2.35bn, R&D/admin cost base, inventory of HK$847.7m and volatile working capital; reserve approximates about 1.5 months of revenue and near one year of 2024 capex plus liquidity buffer.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash needed to keep chip design, R&D, inventory and customer fulfilment running.

cash_breakdown.item: Dividend, FX and tax friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: PRC subsidiary profits distributed offshore may face withholding tax and FX/dividend timing friction; exact distributable cash path is not disclosed.

profit_quality.assessment: 2022-2024 free cash flow after capex was positive, but 2024 cash conversion weakened sharply as operating cash flow fell to 0.47x parent net profit. 2024 profit also benefited from HK$87.8m inventory provision reversal while the core smart-card/security-chip market was weak.
adjustments: Use HK$587.5m 2024 parent net profit as the starting point but remove inventory provision reversal and non-operating associate disposal gain.
Use HK$500m as pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit after considering three-year median profit, 2024 market weakness and non-recurring items.
Apply 0.50 profit haircut because 2024 operating cash flow was materially below profit and working capital released/absorbed cash materially across the last three years.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow: HK$958.9m in 2022, HK$889.3m in 2023, HK$274.4m in 2024. Capex: HK$35.7m, HK$86.2m, HK$90.3m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Stable prior-year cash generation is offset by 2024 revenue decline, pricing pressure, large inventory balance, inventory provision reversal in profit and weak current-year cash conversion.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2024 CFO / parent net profit is about 0.47; three-year median free cash flow remains high but latest-year deterioration is material.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; purchase of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets of HK$90.3m is used as conservative capex evidence.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 working capital changes used cash mainly through lower contract liabilities and payables; inventory and receivables released cash.
